description: Declarative registry for audit-reachability.mjs detector C (optional rigor). A fully general detector for 'strong check conditional, weak check mandatory' cannot be inferred from static analysis alone (see scripts/audit-reachability.mjs and W7 spec), so each known instance is asserted explicitly here instead of guessed at.

pairs.subject: delivery evidence rigor for the mandatory role-pass phase

weak.note: shape-only role-pass validator; a mandatory entry point that always runs

strong.note: structural + policy verification of an anti-fabrication observation record (candidate digest, origin, isolation, required assertions); the real fix (W1b) wired this into scripts/validate-sdlc-role-pass.mjs, not scripts/run-delivery.mjs

pairs.subject: completion signal for the human approval gate shown by the cockpit

strong.note: W8d D4 — satisfyGate supersedes validateReviewAttestation as the strong side of this pair: validateReviewAttestation only ever checked that an attestation record was well-shaped and digest-current, never who signed it or what they decided. satisfyGate calls validateReviewAttestation itself, then additionally requires decision === 'agree', a human reviewer (independence: human-gate, the registered human platform), and re-verifies the gate's own seal. deriveHumanGate now calls satisfyGate directly (lib/cockpit-goal-model.mjs), not validateReviewAttestation — a well-formed, digest-current attestation from an agent, or one that merely exists without agreeing, no longer reads as consent.

pairs.subject: human review gating has two independently declared trigger mechanisms

a.note: boundary gating: a human is required once the action-boundary state is reached

b.note: phase gating: a human is required once role-pass phase 6 is reached
